levels.title: Accounting Foundation
levels.subtitle: From zero to confident basics
levels.description: Accounting terminology, concepts, the accounting equation, journal entries, ledgers, trial balance, cash & bank, and final accounts.

levels.title: Professional Accounting
levels.subtitle: Practical, workplace accounting
levels.description: Receivables, payables, inventory, fixed assets, depreciation, accruals, prepayments, provisions, bad debts, payroll, GST & TDS concepts, month-end closing, financial statements, cash flow basics, controls and MIS.

levels.title: Advanced Accounting
levels.subtitle: Company, partnership, consolidation
levels.description: Company accounts, partnership accounts, branch and departmental accounts, consolidated financial statements, business combinations, cash-flow statements, financial statement analysis, accounting standards and Ind AS concepts.

levels.title: CA Final Level
levels.subtitle: Advanced financial reporting & exam practice
levels.description: Advanced financial reporting, Ind AS, complex accounting adjustments, consolidation, business combinations, integrated case studies, advanced numerical problems, exam-style questions and mock examinations.

disclaimer: This application provides accounting education and CA-level learning content. It is not affiliated with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) and does not confer any professional qualification. Completing this course does not make anyone a Chartered Accountant. Official ICAI syllabus and qualification requirements are separate from this app's learning content and must be satisfied through ICAI's own processes.
